neighbours.label: An action verb in the second conjunct after and
fire: She opened the cupboard and collected the supplies for the trip.
He purchased a wooden pole and used it to support the telescope.
The court examined the evidence and condemned the accused.
The officers reviewed the documents and made their final report.
Peel the eggs and reserve them for the salad.
The soldiers crossed the stream and occupied the hill.
She loosened her grip and let the rope fall.
The committee identified the problem and proposed a practical remedy.
quiet: After opening the cupboard, she collected the supplies for the trip.
After purchasing a wooden pole, he used it to support the telescope.
After examining the evidence, the court condemned the accused.
After reviewing the documents, the officers made their final report.
After peeling the eggs, reserve them for the salad.
After crossing the stream, the soldiers occupied the hill.
After loosening her grip, she let the rope fall.
After identifying the problem, the committee proposed a practical remedy.

notes: Many leading peaks are coordinated verbs. Controls preserve the verbs and events but replace coordination with subordination. No exploratory scoring; no downloaded band scan covers this unit. Sentences written by Codex.
